subject: general
question: How many times does an adult human breathe per minute at rest?
solution:
The correct answer is __**15-18**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An adult human typically breathes **15 to 18** times per minute while at rest.
 
• **Children** tend to breathe faster, with rates often exceeding **20 breaths per minute.**
 
• **Athletes** may have lower resting respiratory rates due to more efficient lung function.
 
• The **average** resting respiratory rate for adults is generally around **16 breaths per minute**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **External Respiration**: The process of exchanging gases (oxygen and carbon dioxide) between the lungs and the blood.
 
• **Internal Respiration**: The exchange of gases between the blood and body tissues at the cellular level.
 
• **Inhalation (Inspiration)**: The Diaphragm contracts and moves downward, and the intercostal muscles contract, expanding the chest cavity and decreasing pressure, allowing air to flow into the lungs.
 
• **Exhalation (Expiration)**: Diaphragm and intercostal muscles relax, the chest cavity decreases, and air is pushed out of the lungs. This process can be passive at rest or active during exertion.
 
• **Oxygen** is transported from the alveoli into the bloodstream, where it binds to hemoglobin in red blood cells.
 
• **Carbon dioxide**, produced by cells as a waste product, is transported from the blood to the alveoli to be exhaled.
